home.title: Rio Nagata
home.aboutText: I'm a web developer with over a year of professional experience building and maintaining WordPress-based websites for Australian businesses, from custom Elementor/ACF page templates to PHP-powered analytics dashboards. I work comfortably across the stack — HTML, CSS, PHP, JavaScript, and MySQL on the code side, alongside WordPress, Gravity Forms, and automation tools like Zapier on the platform side. I enjoy solving problems that go beyond what off-the-shelf plugins can do, whether that's building custom reporting systems, automating bulk data workflows, or designing responsive layouts that align with a brand's identity. Currently seeking new opportunities where I can keep growing as a fullstack developer.

habitquest.title: Vehicle Booking Page
habitquest.description: This website turns habit-building into a game. You can assign experience points to each habit, and when you complete one, you level up, earn in-game currency, and use it to unlock themes and badges for the site. The programming language used for this site is HTML, CSS and React.

oh.title: Officer Handbook
oh.description: Officer Handbook is a centralised workplace knowledge platform I built to improve communication and onboarding in organisations lacking clear documentation. It includes concise guides for tools like Slack, Asana, and Toggl, along with pages covering communication standards and company policies. The platform also features built-in messaging and quizzes to help teams learn, stay aligned, and collaborate more effectively.

portal-app.title: GameStore Admin Portal App
portal-app.description: A full-stack customer intake and analytics platform built with Next.js, Prisma, and PostgreSQL, featuring authentication, real-time filtering, CSV export, and month-by-month data visualization.
